announcements.title: Welcome to TBC Conference
announcements.body: Badges are at the registration desk by the main entrance from 08:00. Coffee is on in the dining area.

announcements.title: Opening keynote in 15 minutes
announcements.body: Jane Doe opens the conference at 11:00 in Talk Room 1. Doors close five minutes before the start.

announcements.title: Oracle panel moved to Talk Room 3
announcements.body: The oracle infrastructure panel now takes place in Talk Room 3. The time is unchanged.

announcements.title: Fire alarm test at 14:00
announcements.body: The venue tests its fire alarm at 14:00 today. No action is needed unless staff ask you to leave the building.
